about: This Collect for Saint Monica recalls her devout tears at the conversion of her son Augustine. It invokes the intercession of both mother and son and asks for two gifts: mourning the petitioners’ sins and finding pardon through God’s grace.

s01.translation: God, comforter of mourners and salvation of those who hope in You, You mercifully received the devout tears of blessed Monica at the conversion of her son Augustine. Through the intercession of them both, grant that we may mourn our sins and find pardon through Your grace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

alignments.gloss: of those who hope in You
through the intercession of them both
who lives and reigns with You

w017.explanation: “Her” refers to Monica, the mother whose tears God received. It does not mean God’s son.

w023.explanation: Both Monica and Augustine are included. The word does not refer to either one alone.

w031.explanation: Pardon is sought through God’s grace. No particular indulgence or its conditions are named.

w032.explanation: Both “to mourn” and “to find” depend on “grant us.” The same petitioners are to do both.

w049.explanation: God describes Christ, the Son, not the Father being addressed. The Son lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
